title: This Deep-Sea Animal Refused Food for 1,868 Days. Nobody Knows Why.
subject: giant isopod

scenes.text: An aquarium animal went five years without a single meal.
It's a giant isopod, almost a foot long, a deep-sea scavenger caught off Mexico in 2007.
On January 2nd, 2009, it walked away from its horse mackerel. And never ate again.
Its keeper moved the food closer, changed the menu, even changed the water temperature. Nothing worked.
It went 1,868 days. It only died in February 2014, and a dissection found no clear cause.
Five years, no food, no explanation. What was it waiting for?

description:
A giant isopod at Japan's Toba Aquarium stopped eating on 2 January 2009 and went 1,868 days without food before dying in February 2014.
Keepers tried different foods and water temperatures, and a dissection found no clear cause.
What do you think it was waiting for?
